Methods S1 Metagenomic analysis of antibiotic resistance genes and methanogenesis in anaerobic digestion

Metagenomic sequencing was conducted to compare ARG profiles and methanogenesis-related metabolic potential in samples collected on days 21 and 49 of AD. Metagenomic DNA was paired-end sequenced on the Illumina NovaSeq 6000 platform. After quality control, clean reads were assembled with MEGAHIT (v1.2.9), and contigs >500 bp were retained. ORFs were predicted using MetaGeneMark (v3.2.6), and coding sequences <100 nt were discarded. A non-redundant gene catalog was generated with CD-HIT (v4.6.1) (95% identity, 90% coverage), and clean reads were mapped back using Bowtie2 (v2.2.0) to estimate gene abundance. Predicted proteins were annotated against the NR_meta and KEGG (v87.1) databases using DIAMOND (v0.9.14), with emphasis on methanogenesis-related genes. ARGs were identified using ARG-OAP 3.0 with the SARG database (E-value < 1e-10, identity ≥ 80%, query coverage ≥ 80%) and normalized to 16S rRNA gene copy numbers. MGEs were quantified using the same criteria.
